name: My Guardian Angel
source: As a shy girl and an amateur stargazer, the astronomy club might be the only place you could fit in on campus. Trying to make some friends there, you soon realize the other two members are just like you - cast out because of their differences. Later, the fourth member makes his appearance, who turns out to be your childhood friend! In the meanwhile, a student psychologist starts meeting with you to help improve your social skills. You begin to develop emotional bonding with these guys. What will happen next? Will you be able to find your true love?
translation: 身为害羞的女孩与业余观星爱好者，天文社或许是校园里唯一适合你的地方。为了交些朋友，你加入其中，却很快发现，另外两名成员也和你一样，因与众不同而遭到排斥。后来，第四位成员出现了，竟然是你的青梅竹马！与此同时，一位学生心理咨询师也开始与你会面，帮助你提升社交能力。你逐渐与这些男生产生情感上的联系。接下来会发生什么？你能找到真爱吗？
